mechanism: Deutetrabenazine is metabolized by CYP2D6 and letrozole may have minor effects on CYP450 metabolism; additive CNS effects and potential QT prolongation concern with deutetrabenazine's cardiac effects.
action: Monitor for increased deutetrabenazine adverse effects (sedation, hypotension, QT prolongation); baseline and periodic ECG monitoring recommended; dose adjustment of deutetrabenazine may be necessary.
